import json, subprocess, sys
# Save-name overwrite: the registry keeps only the newest checkpoint per name,
# and the registry itself never rewinds.
run = {'banks':1,'load_balancers':1,'fifo_bytes':100,'pifo_bytes':100,'refill_batch':2,
       'sample_period':100000,'borders':[0,50],
       'policy':{'kind':'fifo'},
       'events':[['enqueue',1,1,1,0],['save',7],['enqueue',2,1,1,0],['save',7],
                 ['enqueue',3,1,1,0],['restore',7],['inspect',1],['inspect',2],
                 ['inspect',3],['restore',7],['inspect',2],['dequeue',3]]}
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','/workspace/submission/cli.py'],
                   input=json.dumps({'runs':[run]}).encode(),capture_output=True,cwd='/workspace')
out = json.loads(p.stdout)['runs'][0]
for row in out['log']:
    print(row)
print('state queues', out['state']['queues'], 'policy', out['state']['policy'])
assert out['log'][5] == [5,'restore',7]
assert out['log'][6] == [6,'inspect',1,[1,0,'fifo',1,1,0]]      # from the second save
assert out['log'][7] == [7,'inspect',2,[2,0,'fifo',1,1,0]]      # present at second save
assert out['log'][8] == [8,'inspect',3,None]                     # discarded branch packet
assert out['log'][10] == [10,'inspect',2,[2,0,'fifo',1,1,0]]     # repeated restore works
assert out['state']['policy'] == {'kind':'fifo','time':2}        # rank state rewound to save
assert [q['fifo'] for q in out['state']['queues']] == [[1,2]]
print('save-overwrite + repeated restore ok')
EOF
